lessons: Premise is false: the ticket needs a Node subprocess in tests/integration/test_step_view_unknown_kind.py, but tests/integration/conftest.py guards every file not listed in REAL_IO_TESTS. That conftest is outside the fence, and this is a rendering test, not a real-I/O test.
Criteria 1-2 fail either way: unguarded, the test raises IntegrationIOBlocked; marked disk_io_skip, it is skipped, so the Verification command can never pass as written.

Criterion 3 is also unverifiable: the run record says tests/integration/test_step_icons.py (the Node icon harness) is skipped under the current integration configuration, so it no longer proves every STEP_KINDS entry has its own icon.

Before re-filing, name an approved way to run the JS harness (for example, a REAL_IO_TESTS entry the test policy allows, or a Node test runner outside pytest integration), and fence its owning files, such as tests/integration/conftest.py.

Keep the extension.js change as specified: unknown kind gives ThemeIcon 'warning' and description 'cannot draw the clutch snapshot: unknown step kind <kind>', and known kinds stay unchanged. Only the test plan and fence need rework.
